ORDINANCE NO. 5-103
(of Clark County, Nevada)
AN ORDINANCE TO ADOPT THE DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT WITH
TOLL SOUTH LV LLC FOR A SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL
SUBDIVISION ON 0.89 ACRES, GENERALLY LOCATED EAST OF
HINSON STREET AND NORTH OF SILVERADO RANCH BOULEVARD
WITHIN ENTERPRISE, AND PROVIDING FOR OTHER MATTERS
PROPERLY RELATED THERETO.
THE BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF THE COUNTY OF CLARK, STATE OF NEVADA, DOES HEREBY
ORDAIN AS FOLLOWS:
SECTION 1 In accordance with the provisions of Section 278.0203 of the Nevada Revised Statutes ^d Chapter 30.06 of the
Clark County Code, the Development Agreement with Toll South LV LLC for a single-family residential subdivision on 0.89 acres,
eenerallv located east of Hinson Street and north of Silverado Ranch Boulevard withm Enterprise, is hereby adopted.
SECTION 2. If any section of this ordinance or portion thereof is for any reason held invalid or unconstitutional by any court o
competent jurisdiction, such holding shall not invalidate the remaining parts of this ordinance. . .
SECTION 3. All ordinances, parts of ordinances, chapters, sections, subsections, clauses, phrases or sentences contamed in the
Clark County Code in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.
SECTION 4 This ordinance shall take effect and be in force from and after its passage and the publication thereof by title o y,
together with names of the County Commissioners voting for or against its passage, in a newspap^ published m^d having a g^eral
circulation in Clark County, Nevada, at least once a week for a period of two (2) weeks and shall be effective on and from the fifteenth day
after passage.
PROPOSED on the 8th day of I u B l 2026
